as_told.title: Hoagland's Face on Mars and Cydonia pyramids

plain: A region of Mars called Cydonia holds several pyramids, basically the remnants of a city, according to Michels, who tells it in an episode about whether Mars once had life. In another episode he credits the idea to Richard Hoagland, whom he calls "the face on Mars guy" after a formation there said to look like a face, and to Hoagland's book Dark Mission: The Secret History of NASA. If it were true, it would mean someone once built on Mars.
